id: title:dmarticus:reduce self driving inbox load time

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop API client and UI request optimization for report inbox sections, potentially reducing payload and latency for decision-count queries.
review.reason: Adds a `count_only=true` parameter to the reports API and its callers, allowing the backend to return only a count without fetching report rows. This is a substantive, bounded performance and payload optimization. Tests and documentation are also updated. No database or shared dependency changes are present, and the implementation is localized to the API and its callers.
review.uncertainty: The actual runtime benefit and adoption are not demonstrated; this is a potential optimization rather than a realized systemic improvement. No tier assignment performed; score and explanation are withheld pending the next instruction.
